Fishing Area Country Analysis

Source: R/fishing_area_country.R
fishing_area_country.Rd

This function analyzes the fishing area data and generates plots for specified country based on their ranking in terms of total tonnes.

Usage

fishing_area_country(
  area_data,
  rank_range = c(1, 10),
  plot = TRUE,
  table = TRUE,
  timeseries_analysis = TRUE,
  line_width = 1.5,
  point_size = 1.8,
  point_alpha = 0.7,
  point_shape = 1,
  line_alpha = 0.7,
  axis_text_size = 10,
  axis_title_size = 10,
  strip_text_size = 10,
  axis_text_face = "plain",
  axis_title_face = "bold",
  strip_text_face = "bold",
  smooth_method = "loess",
  smooth_linetype = "dashed",
  line_linewidth = 1.5,
  text_hjust = 0.9,
  text_vjust = -4,
  text_size = 4.5,
  text_color = "black",
  facet_ncol = 2,
  h_value = 0.15,
  ZH = FALSE,
  lang = NULL,
  pptx = getOption("faofishingreport.pptx", FALSE)
)

Arguments

area_data

A data frame containing the fishing area data.

rank_range

A numeric vector of length 2 specifying the rank range of country to be analyzed.

plot

A logical value indicating whether to generate and save plots.

table

A logical value indicating whether to generate and save tables

timeseries_analysis

A logical value indicating whether to analysis timeseries.

line_width

A numeric value specifying the line width. Default is 1.5.

point_size

A numeric value specifying the point size. Default is 1.8.

point_alpha

A numeric value specifying the point alpha. Default is 0.7.

point_shape

A numeric or character value specifying the shape of the points. Default is 1.

line_alpha

A numeric value specifying the line alpha. Default is 0.7.

axis_text_size

A numeric value specifying the size of the axis text. Default is 10.

axis_title_size

A numeric value specifying the size of the axis title. Default is 10.

strip_text_size

A numeric value specifying the size of the strip text. Default is 10.

axis_text_face

The font face of the axis text. Default is "plain".

axis_title_face

The font face of the axis title. Default is "bold".

strip_text_face

The font face of the strip text. Default is "bold".

smooth_method

A character string specifying the smoothing method to be used. Default is "loess".

smooth_linetype

A character string specifying the line type for the smoothing curve. Default is "dashed".

line_linewidth

A numeric value specifying the line width for the line geom. Default is 1.5.

text_hjust

A numeric value specifying the horizontal justification of the text geom. Default is 0.9.

text_vjust

A numeric value specifying the vertical justification of the text geom. Default is -4.

text_size

A numeric value specifying the size of the text geom. Default is 4.5.

text_color

A character string specifying the color of the text geom. Default is "black".

facet_ncol

A numeric value specifying the number of columns to be used in facet_wrap. Default is 2.

h_value

The minimum segment size passed to strucchange::breakpoints(): a fraction of the series length (default 0.15) or a number of years.

ZH

A logical value. If TRUE, chart text and names are in Chinese. Default is FALSE. ZH = TRUE is the same as lang = "zh".

lang

The language of the chart text and names: "en" (English), "zh" (Chinese) or "both" (Chinese and English). Default is NULL, which uses "zh" if ZH = TRUE, and otherwise the language set with fao_settings() ("en" unless changed).

pptx

A logical value. Charts are always saved as PNG in figures/png/; if TRUE they are also saved as editable PowerPoint files in figures/pptx/. Default is FALSE, which can be changed for all functions with fao_settings(pptx = TRUE).

Value

A list with area_country (yearly catch of every country in the area), area_country_ranked (yearly catch of the ranked countries, with the others grouped), area_country_ranked_total (total catch and rank of the selected countries) and coefs_data (start year, end year and mean catch of each period between breakpoints). Charts and tables are saved if plot and table are TRUE.

See also

Other fishing area analyses: fishing_area_data(), fishing_area_species()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
fishing_area_country(FAO34[["area_data"]], c(1, 10), plot=TRUE,table=TRUE,h_value=0.15) #area_data=Fao34
} # }
